lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately six horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal spot rows to form a lattice-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots located within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated on the lower half.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are attached to the ventral margin of the pectoral fin and the lower abdominal region.
